record.paper_title: Open Problems on Graph Coloring for Special Graph Classes
record.original_question: A graph is chordal bipartite if it is bipartite and every induced cycle in it has exactly four vertices. What is the computational complexity of List 3-Coloring on chordal bipartite graphs, where each vertex has a list of allowed colors drawn from {1, 2, 3} and the task is to find a proper coloring respecting the lists? What is the computational complexity of 3-Precoloring Extension on chordal bipartite graphs, where a partial 3-coloring is given and the task is to decide whether it extends to a proper 3-coloring of the whole graph?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 3 Determine the complexity of the problems List 3-Coloring and 3-Precoloring Extension for the class of chordal bipartite graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph G=(V,E) is called chordal bipartite if it is bipartite and every induced cycle in G has exactly four vertices (equivalently, G is bipartite and contains no induced cycle of length at least 6).

Consider the following two decision problems on chordal bipartite graphs:

(a) LIST 3-COLORING. Given a chordal bipartite graph G=(V,E) together with a list assignment L: V → 2^{{1,2,3}}, decide whether there exists a proper coloring c: V → {1,2,3} such that c(v) ∈ L(v) for every v ∈ V and c(u) ≠ c(v) whenever uv ∈ E.

(b) 3-PRECOLORING EXTENSION. Given a chordal bipartite graph G=(V,E), a subset W ⊆ V, and a proper coloring c_W : W → {1,2,3}, decide whether c_W can be extended to a proper 3-coloring c: V → {1,2,3} of G.

Determine the computational complexity of each of these two problems on the class of chordal bipartite graphs: is each of them solvable in polynomial time, or is it NP-complete?
artifact.status_search_result: The complexity of List 3-Coloring and 3-Precoloring Extension restricted to chordal bipartite graphs is reported as open in the literature. Related results show that 4-List Coloring is NP-complete on P8-free chordal bipartite graphs, 4-Precoloring Extension is NP-complete on P10-free chordal bipartite graphs, and 3-Precoloring Extension is NP-complete on bipartite (and planar bipartite) graphs in general, but no resolution of the 3-coloring variants on chordal bipartite graphs has been found.

status_evidence.snippet: Determine the complexity of the problems List 3-Coloring and 3-Precoloring Extension for the class of chordal bipartite graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Coloring Problems on Bipartite Graphs of Small Diameter
status_evidence.snippet: 4-PreExt is NP-complete on P10-free chordal bipartite graphs and 4-List Coloring is NP-complete on P8-free chordal bipartite graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Hardness is known for the 4-color variants on subclasses; the 3-color cases remain open on chordal bipartite graphs.
